VBO:0200915.summary: Mountain-type dogs form a broad FCI grouping with varied working histories. It includes the Pyrenean Mountain Dog, a flock guardian, and the Newfoundland, whose standard describes hauling loads and working in water.
VBO:0200915.shortDescription: Mountain-type dogs include distinct working breeds, from Pyrenean flock guardians to Newfoundlands.
